command: set -euo pipefail; ACTIVE="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; test -d "$ACTIVE/.git"; test "$(git -C "$ACTIVE" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test ! -e "${HOME}/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4"; CLEAN_PATH='/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin'; unset VIRTUAL_ENV CONDA_PREFIX PYTHONHOME || true; export PATH="$CLEAN_PATH"; source "$ACTIVE/export.sh"; idf.py --version | tee /tmp/idf-version-v554-single.txt; grep -Eq 'ESP-IDF v5\.5\.4($|[- ])' /tmp/idf-version-v554-single.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'SINGLE_ACTIVE_IDF=%s\n' "$ACTIVE"
